ex.en: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
ex.zh: 這份作業花了我比預期還久的時間。

ex.en: The assignment is due next Monday.
It's necessary that we all work together to complete this assignment.
ex.zh: 我們必須同心協力才能完成這項任務。

ex.en: I was abroad on an assignment.
ex.zh: 我那時被派到國外出任務。

ex.en: Students are graded by continuous assessment.
ex.zh: 學生的成績是透過持續評量來決定的。

ex.en: We need a careful assessment of the risks.
ex.zh: 我們需要仔細評估風險。

ex.en: This bookcase is easy to assemble.
I'll keep the instructions you sent for assembling the furniture.
ex.zh: 你寄來的家具組裝說明，我會留著。

ex.en: The teacher assembled the students in the hall.
ex.zh: 老師把學生集合在禮堂。

ex.en: The cars move slowly along the assembly line.
ex.zh: 汽車沿著裝配線緩緩移動。

ex.en: He worked on an assembly line for ten years.
ex.zh: 他在生產線上工作了十年。

ex.en: My boss assigned the hard job to me.
ex.zh: 我老闆把艱鉅的任務指派給了我。

ex.en: She assigned the work to him.
ex.zh: 她把這個工作派給他做。

ex.en: The teacher assigned us ten problems for homework.
ex.zh: 老師出了十題作業給我們。
